neighbours.label: ' H' split off as the first letter of a place name (Hanoi, Huddersfield, Hertford); place names that are one token, including Helsinki and Havana, stay quiet
fire: Our office is based in Harnham near the river.
Flights to Hanoi leave twice a week.

She went to school in Hertford with her sister.
The team plays in Hopton on Saturday.
We spent a week in Hanoi and loved it.
The train stops at Huddersfield before Leeds.
He was born in Hertford, north of London.
quiet: Our office is based in Leeds near the river.

short: split-off ' H' of a place name
notes: Card: ' H' x26 in Harnham, Hanoi, Hertford, Huddersfield, Hopton. Probe: Harnham 0.79, Hanoi 0.77, Huddersfield 0.70, Hertford 0.67; ' H' of Helen 0.36 after 'Her friend', Leeds, Paris, Manchester at most 0.01. Tokenizer checked; Helsinki and Havana are one token and are used as near misses.
